name: Beastbond Paws banishes itself to buff a target Animal/Beast ally
notes: Beastbond Paws' element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost (0) needs no floating-payment setup. Cheerful Slime (an ALLY, TAMER,ANIMAL,SLIME) is seeded onto the field as the required Animal/Beast target.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Target Animal or Beast ally you control gets +1 [POWER] and gains true sight until end of turn.
